title: Uniqueness and residue compatibility of normalized tangent charts
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring with its actual tangent grading [def-sfb-nodal-tangent-comparison-data] and degree-zero residue isomorphism [lem-sfb-nodal-tangent-canonical-grading]. If f∈m generates mB, then f^n divides every a∈m^n in B. Consequently two ring equivalences from the homogeneous f-chart to E satisfying the normalized division formula coincide. If f is regular in B and its basic open is all of Proj, any two normalized Proj≅Spec E isomorphisms coincide. Every such normalized isomorphism commutes with the maps to Spec(A/m) through the canonical degree-zero residue isomorphism.

proof.text: Every homogeneous-localization element has a representative a/ℓ^n. Membership of its numerator in the image grading lifts it to a graded piece, and quotient surjectivity lifts it further to an element of m^n. Apply the two normalized formulas with the same division coefficient. RingEquiv.ext gives equality.
